    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>

    <description>
      <![CDATA[
        <item-data>
          Description with <tags> and entity &extended; inside CDATA.
        </item-data>
      ]]>
    </description>
  </item>
</catalog>

  %ext-entity;
]>
<?target-pi data="test-mode"?>
<document xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/doc" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Comment explaining the entity chain -->
  <section xsi:schemaLocation="http://schemas.example.org/doc schema.xsd">

      Parsing complex chain: γ
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>
    γ
  </section>
</document>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-a "Entity A">
  <!ENTITY ent-b "Entity B &ent-a;">
  <!ENTITY ent-c "Entity C &ent-b;">
  <!ENTITY % core-macro "<!ENTITY ent-d 'Entity D'>">
  %core-macro;
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" target="parser"?>
<archive xmlns="urn:archive:schema" xmlns:meta="urn:archive:meta">
  <!-- Comment regarding entity expansions -->
  <record>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw CDATA containing entity &ent-c; and &ent-d;.
    ]]>
  </record>
  <meta:record>&ent-c; &ent-d;</meta:record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY item-name "Widget">
  <!ENTITY item-desc "A standard &item-name; with features.">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % ent-set "<!ENTITY macro-text 'MacroExpanded'>">
  %ent-set;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="inventory.css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:store="http://inventory.org/store">
  <!-- First top-level comment -->
  <!-- Second consecutive comment to check comment stream handling -->
  <store:item>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with &item-desc; and &macro-text;
    ]]>
  </store:item>
  <item>&item-desc;</item>
</inventory>
```
